overview: The Conservation Commission approved an Order of Conditions for the Route 28 pathway and boardwalk project with a pre-construction operations and maintenance condition. The commission also reviewed a Notice of Intent to demolish and reconstruct a single-family home at 53 Winford Way, continuing the hearing pending revised plans, delineation data, and a potential site visit.

items.title: Continuances from December 18, 2024
items.summary: Hearings for Notices of Intent for sewer road improvements (DEP #215-0239) and 28 Sycamore Avenue (DEP #215-0238) were continued to January 22, 2025.

items.title: Notice of Intent: Route 28 Pathway and Boardwalk (DEP #215-0240)
items.summary: The commission voted to issue an Order of Conditions for pathways and a boardwalk under the Route 28 Fellsway bridge, adding a condition that a draft operations and maintenance plan be submitted two weeks prior to construction.

items.title: Notice of Intent: 53 Winford Way (DEP #215-0241)
items.summary: The commission continued the hearing to January 22, requesting wetland delineation data sheets, evaluation of a retaining wall to pull work back from the wetland, tree preservation details, and a potential site visit.

items.title: General Business and Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on scheduling a South Street item, outstanding meeting minutes, and coordinating upcoming site visits.
